brief: I need a system for a small city team to handle streetlight repair requests: classify reports, find existing tickets and route to the right maintenance crew. Five operators handle about 200 reports a day. It must not remotely control equipment.

Design a small daily report that joins two CSV files by order ID. One has promised-delivery timestamps and the other actual-delivery timestamps, both ISO UTC. Flag delivered orders more than 24 hours late and export a CSV for the operations team. No emails, remote updates, forecasting or conversational interface.
Help a small shop triage customer support and draft useful replies. Staff review every reply before sending.
Read invoice documents, explain PO mismatches and prepare an AP analyst review packet. No posting, payment or supplier-master updates.
Help a product team find evidence in its supplied research notes and draft a weekly decision brief. Cite evidence and state disagreement.
I want to automate our onboarding.
